items_org_sku_unique.name: items_org_sku_unique
items_org_sku_unique.where: sku is not null and archived_at is null

items_type_shape.name: items_type_shape
items_type_shape.value:
(type = 'asset' and asset_state is not null and quantity_available is null)
    or (type = 'consumable' and asset_state is null and quantity_available is not null and current_holder_id is null)

jobs_org_code_unique.name: jobs_org_code_unique
jobs_org_code_unique.where: code is not null and archived_at is null

tx_holder_required.name: tx_holder_required
tx_holder_required.value: type not in ('checkout','checkin') or holder_id is not null

tx_correction_linked.name: tx_correction_linked
tx_correction_linked.value: type <> 'correction' or corrects_transaction_id is not null
